csv_scope_of_work: The Northwest Hills Council of Governments (NHCOG) is seeking to pre-qualify an engineering consultant(s) or engineering firm(s) to assist the NHCOG and member towns in a variety of civil engineering activities. Assist NHCOG member towns with other engineering tasks as needed (e.g. local roadway and bridge design or improvement, drainage needs, material testing, subdivision review, dam review/projects, improvements to town facilities, sanitary sewer and utility projects, budget estimates for construction activities) .
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Materials Testing, Sanitation Engineering, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics, Stormwater, Traffic Design Engineering

title: NHCOG - Civil Engineering Activities
short_description: Prequalification of engineering consultants for municipal civil engineering and bridge-related tasks.
project_scope: Framework-style prequalification for Northwest Hills Council of Governments and member towns covering a broad range of municipal civil engineering activities as needed, including local roadway and bridge design or improvement, drainage needs, material testing, subdivision review, dam review/projects, improvements to town facilities, sanitary sewer and utility projects, and construction budget estimates. No specific project, dimensions, spans, quantities, or construction volumes are defined.
services: Prequalification of engineering consultants/firms for civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, materials testing, sanitation engineering, structural engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, and traffic design engineering services; may include roadway and bridge design/improvement support.
relevance_explanation:
- Broad on-call/prequalification procurement without a defined structure or project.
- Includes bridge-related tasks, but only as one minor part of a wide municipal engineering scope.
- No specific span, structural type, architectural ambition, or innovative lightweight/sustainable feature stated.
- Strong focus on general civil engineering, drainage, utilities, testing, and municipal support services, which are only marginally aligned with sbp.
- Resembles a framework/multi-task arrangement without technical specification, which is generally low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice is a prequalification/on-call consulting procurement for multiple possible municipal tasks, with no defined project scope, quantities, or budget. A realistic project-specific construction cost estimate is not possible from the available information.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. As this is a prequalification for undefined future assignments and no project budget, fee basis, or anticipated task volume is provided, a realistic sbp fee estimate is not possible.
references_qualifications: Consultants/firms are sought for prequalification in civil engineering and related disciplines including geotechnical engineering, materials testing, sanitation engineering, structural engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, stormwater, and traffic design engineering. Specific reference counts or minimum qualification thresholds are not stated in the provided text.
award_criteria: One or more contracts may be awarded. Specific award criteria and weighting are not stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: Northwest Hills Council of Governments (NHCOG), Goshen, CT, USA. Contact: Erik Shortell. Phone: 860-491-9884. Email: eshortell@nhcogct.gov. Website: https://www.nhcogct.gov/reports-publications-rfp-rfq
notes: The notice is for prequalification/on-call municipal engineering support rather than a single defined bridge project. It includes bridge design/improvement among many other services. Questions deadline: 06/08/2026 05:00 PM EDT. Solicitation documents are available online.
